note: Better Search Block themes the core search block and (optionally) the search-results page form via hook_form_alter() + CSS. All state is one config object, better_search.settings, with keys placeholder_text, theme (int 0-3: 0 background fade, 1 expand on hover, 2 expand icon on hover, 3 slide icon on hover), size, searchpage_enable, searchpage_submit_not_visible, input_name (default keys), block_form_id (default search_block_form). Settings form is route better_search_settings at /admin/config/search/better-search, gated by the 'administer Better Search settings' permission. No schema, plugins, services or Drush. Medium cases seed known placeholder/theme values to read back; hard cases have the agent change the theme and the placeholder, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: Using the Drupal Better Search Block module, how do I change the placeholder text shown inside the search box, and in which config object / settings page is that stored?
evals.expected_output: Set placeholder_text on the settings form at /admin/config/search/better-search (route better_search_settings); it is saved to config better_search.settings key placeholder_text.

evals.prompt: What animation styles does the Better Search Block module offer for the search box, and how is the chosen style stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: Four CSS styles selected by the integer theme key in better_search.settings: 0 Background Fade (better_search/background_fade), 1 Expand on Hover, 2 Expand Icon on Hover (increase_icon_size), 3 Slide Icon on Hover (on_hover_button).

evals.prompt: Which form does Better Search Block restyle by default, and how would I make it style a different (custom) search block instead?
evals.expected_output: Its hook_form_alter() targets the form id in better_search.settings block_form_id (default search_block_form) plus core's search_form. To style a custom search form, change block_form_id (and input_name) in the advanced settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, Better Search Block has a custom placeholder configured for the search box. Inspect the live configuration and state the exact placeholder text.
evals.expected_output: The placeholder is 'Find content here' (config better_search.settings key placeholder_text).

evals.prompt: Which Better Search Block animation style is currently active on this site? Inspect the live configuration and identify the style (by its theme value and/or name).
evals.expected_output: theme is 3, i.e. 'Slide Icon on Hover' (library better_search/on_hover_button), in config better_search.settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Better Search Block to use the 'Expand on Hover' animation style for the search box, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: config better_search.settings theme is set to 1 (Expand on Hover), e.g. drush cset better_search.settings theme 1, or the 'Expand on Hover' radio on /admin/config/search/better-search.

evals.prompt: I want my search box to show the words 'Type to search' inside it before anyone types. Set that up on my Drupal site using Better Search Block.
evals.expected_output: config better_search.settings placeholder_text is set to 'Type to search', e.g. drush cset better_search.settings placeholder_text 'Type to search', or the Placeholder Text field on /admin/config/search/better-search.
